name: @calle-ai/calle
description: TypeScript server SDK for the CALL-E Developer API.

scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc --noEmit --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --types node examples/create-and-wait.ts examples/webhook-server.ts
scripts.test:package: pnpm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then((mod) => { if (typeof mod.CalleClient !== 'function') process.exit(1); })"
scripts.test:tarball: pnpm run build && rm -f calle-ai-calle-*.tgz && tarball=$(npm pack --silent) && smoke_dir=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$smoke_dir" && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm install "$OLDPWD/$tarball" >/dev/null && node --input-type=module -e "import('@calle-ai/calle').then((mod) => { if (typeof mod.CalleClient !== 'function') process.exit(1); })"
